articles.title: Mississauga man, 36, faces new charges in human trafficking investigation, police say
articles.summary: A Mississauga man accused of human trafficking is facing additional charges after two more alleged victims came forward, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Multi-vehicle crash closes portion of Hwy. 27 near Nobleton
articles.summary: A multi-vehicle crash closed Highway 27 for almost two hours in both directions near Nobleton. Police in York Region say two vehicles collided on Highway 27 between 15th and 16th Sideroad around 7:30 p.m. Friday. There was no immediate word on any injuries. The highway was reopened to traffic around 9 p.m.

articles.summary: One person is in custody following a shooting in Scarborough on Friday night.

articles.title: Toronto man arrested in connection to alleged sexual assault in Markham
articles.summary: A 31-year-old man is facing a sexual assault charge and investigators believe there may be other victims.

articles.title: Mississauga’s mayoral race is neck and neck, poll suggests
articles.summary: The race for becoming Mississauga’s next mayor is currently a coin toss between former mayor Bonnie Crombie and current mayor Carolyn Parrish, a new poll suggests.

articles.summary: The first day of practice and qualifying at the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham has been cancelled because incomplete track.

articles.title: Stellantis is considering closing and selling Brampton assembly plant, Unifor says
articles.summary: A national union says it was told by Stellantis this week that it is seriously considering the closure and sale of the Brampton assembly plant. In a statement, Stellantis said its focus remains on finding a sustainable manufacturing solution for the plant.

articles.title: Stellantis seriously considering closure and sale of idled Brampton plant: union
articles.summary: TORONTO — Unifor says Stellantis is seriously considering the closure and sale of its Brampton, Ont., assembly plant, which has been idled since 2023.

articles.title: Toronto police asking public to help fully ID suspect in 2022 fatal Scarborough shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police partially identified a man named Jay as the suspect in a 2022 Scarborough parking lot shooting that killed a man.

articles.title: What to expect as IndyCar gets underway in Markham
articles.summary: It’s about to get loud in Markham. The city is playing host to the NTT IndyCar Series — among other motorsports series — this weekend for the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy.

articles.title: A Canadian payment giant is being sold to U.S. private equity. Is your digital privacy at risk?
articles.summary: Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of Montreal are selling payment processor Moneris Solutions Corp. to San Francisco-based investment firm Francisco Partners. Some analysts are raising concerns around what the deal means for Canada's digital sovereignty amid the country's trade war with the U.S.
